candidates.claim: The trunk GigabitEthernet1/0/22 on sw-core-01 allows VLANs 10, 30 and 99, but the approved set is {10,99}, so the unauthorized VLAN 30 (CORP) is carried on this trunk.
candidates.remediation: Remove VLAN 30 from the allowed list of sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/22 so that it carries only VLANs 10 and 99.

candidates.claim: The allowed VLAN list of sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/22 changed from the approved baseline {10,99} to {10,30,99}, and this deviation is reported for reconciliation.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the deviation by reverting GigabitEthernet1/0/22 to the approved VLAN set {10,99} or by documenting and approving the new set.
